extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. Used to train and evaluate Arabic OCR models for converting Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad, 'Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction,' arXiv:2411.17835v1 [cs.CL], 19 Nov 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website (https://www.hindawi.org/), converted to PDFs and paired with extracted Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content from the Hindawi website was scraped, converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs to generate Arabic book page images, and Markdown text was extracted from the HTML to form paired training samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (Markdown representations) were automatically generated from HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, without manual human annotation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is open-sourced and available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedRashad/arabic-img2md. No explicit versioning or deprecation policy is described.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset supports the digitization and structured extraction of Arabic text from books, contributing to the preservation and accessibility of Arabic literature and promoting NLP research for underrepresented languages.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Expanding the dataset to include diverse genres and styles is critical for improving model robustness.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is derived exclusively from Hindawi's web content and may not generalize to other domains of Arabic text such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. It was exclusively used to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat, not arabic-small-nougat. Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts containing dense tables, charts, or images may not be well represented.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR models for converting Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. A test set of 160 random, unseen Arabic book pages was used for evaluation. The dataset enables accurate and scalable Arabic OCR training and evaluation.
